title: 🇧🇼 Botswana
description: Curated lists of the best safari experiences, mokoro rides, and wildlife encounters in Botswana — researched from thousands of real Reddit reviews.

places.name: 9 Best Mokoro Canoe Rides in the Okavango Delta
places.description: The best mokoro canoe rides in the Okavango Delta — budget trips from Maun, luxury camp excursions, multi-day wilderness expeditions.

places.name: 8 Best Safari Camps in Chobe
places.description: The best safari camps and lodges in Chobe National Park — riverfront luxury, mobile glamping, budget camps with elephants at your doorstep.

places.name: 11 Best Bushman Cultural Experiences in the Kalahari
places.description: San tracking walks, trance dances, fire-making & ancient rock art — community lodges to luxury camps across Botswana, Namibia & South Africa.

places.name: 13 Best Makgadikgadi Salt Pans Experiences
places.description: Quad biking on the pans, meerkat habituation at sunrise, zebra migration, sleep-under-the-stars camps & Kubu Island baobabs.

places.name: 13 Best Sunset Cruises on the Chobe River
places.description: G&T sundowners with hippos & elephants — photo boats, luxury houseboats, budget cruises & private charters from Kasane.

places.name: 13 Best Luxury Safari Lodges in the Okavango Delta
places.description: Mombo, Jao, Xaranna & more — the world's finest safari lodges on Chief's Island and the Okavango floodplains.

places.name: 13 Best Budget Stays & Hostels in Maun
places.description: Old Bridge Backpackers, Audi Camp & more — the gateway to the Okavango Delta doesn't have to break the bank.

places.name: 15 Best Birding Spots at Nata Bird Sanctuary
places.description: 250,000 flamingos turning the salt pans pink, pelican colonies, 165+ species & night drives for aardvarks.

places.name: 12 Best Rock Art Sites at Tsodilo Hills
places.description: Botswana's only UNESCO World Heritage Site — 4,500+ paintings spanning 100,000 years, the "Louvre of the Desert."
